description: CSS-only avatar shell: a photo , an initials / icon fallback stacked under it, and an optional presence dot. No JavaScript; the accessible name comes from the img alt, or from role="img" + aria-label on the host when the avatar is initials-only.

attributes.name: data-size
attributes.description: Size: xs (1.5rem) to 2xl (8rem); omit for md (3rem). Initials never drop below 0.625rem.

attributes.name: data-shape
attributes.description: rounded (large radius) or square (medium radius) instead of a circle.

attributes.name: data-ring
attributes.description: Decorative ring (surface gap + border colour); kept inside overlap clusters, drawn as an outline in forced colours.

childAttributes.name: data-fallback
childAttributes.description: Initials or icon shown when there is no photo; stacked under the , so a failed or transparent image reveals it. Add aria-hidden="true" when the host or img already carries the name.

childAttributes.name: data-status
childAttributes.description: Presence dot (colour + shape). Give it text: role="img" aria-label="Online", or text content, which is read but clipped visually.
